stories.headline: Google just made Gemini Live think out loud before it answers
stories.blurb: Gemini 3.8 Live now has an 'Extended Thinking' mode that pauses to reason through problems step-by-step before responding. It's designed for math, coding, and complex questions where you'd rather wait 10 seconds for a thoughtful answer than get a fast wrong one. Available now in Gemini Advanced.
stories.why_it_matters: Voice AI is moving from instant responses to deliberate reasoning—closer to how humans actually think through hard problems.
stories.original_headline: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking

stories.headline: NVIDIA's new Vera Rubin chip just swept every MLPerf inference benchmark
stories.blurb: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72 topped all categories in the latest MLPerf tests, the industry standard for measuring AI inference speed. The chip handles both text generation and image tasks faster than any competitor, while NVIDIA's software optimizations mean companies can squeeze more performance from existing hardware without buying new servers.
stories.why_it_matters: Faster inference means lower costs per AI response and more users served with the same infrastructure.
stories.original_headline: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Delivers Leading Performance in MLPerf Inference v6.1 Debut

stories.headline: Amazon opens Alexa+ early access to everyone in India
stories.blurb: Amazon is rolling out Alexa+ to all customers in India during an early access phase, including Hindi language support. The assistant can now understand and respond in Hindi alongside English, making voice AI accessible to hundreds of millions more users.
stories.why_it_matters: First major voice assistant to ship native Hindi at scale in India's massive market.
stories.original_headline: Amazon launches Alexa+ in India with Hindi support

stories.headline: Meta bundles Instagram, WhatsApp, and AI credits into paid subscriptions
stories.blurb: Meta's new "One" subscriptions combine its standalone app features with extra AI usage allowances. The bundles are launching globally today in multiple tiers for individuals, creators, and businesses. This follows Meta's recent launch of its Muse AI assistant and builds on bundles that were being tested earlier this year.
stories.why_it_matters: Meta's betting people will pay monthly for social media plus AI rather than just ads.
stories.original_headline: Meta’s new One subscriptions put a price on social media and AI
